verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes an llms.txt (confirmed live by probe with HTTP 200) and an llms-full.txt. It also has a dedicated agents.md page explaining that every docs page is served as clean Markdown by appending `.md`, plus an agent-setup SKILL.md an agent can read and execute. missing for 10: independent community or hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs in practice.
